Answer: C
Reason: The serial chest X-rays demonstrate an initial presentation of bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates that progress to more dense consolidation before showing significant resolution by day 4 (Figure 4a). This rapid clearance of extensive parenchymal opacities is characteristic of Exercise-Induced Pulmonary Haemorrhage (EIPH), distinguishing it from infectious pneumonia or malignancy which typically resolve much more slowly.
